welcome.title: Welcome to the Clinic Demo
welcome.body:
You are exploring VetoCrm on a pre-filled clinic account, in read-only mode.

This tour covers the dashboard, client & patient records, medical files, documents (X-rays, labs, certificates), calendar, farm visits, inventory and more — just like daily practice, without changing any data.

navigation.title: Main menu
navigation.body:
The top bar opens every clinic module: dashboard, clients, patients, appointments, visits, consultations, vaccinations, antiparasitics, history, farms, stock, accounting and settings.

On mobile, a bottom bar complements this menu.

dashboardHero.title: Dashboard — overview
dashboardHero.body:
Daily entry point: welcome message, key metrics (clients, patients, today’s appointments) and shortcuts to frequent actions.

In read-only demo, create buttons may be hidden or blocked — no writes are allowed.

dashboardTabs.title: KPIs, activity & charts
dashboardTabs.body:
Tabs switch between summary, detailed KPIs, recent activity and charts (consultations, vaccinations, etc.).

Useful to grasp clinic workload at a glance.

clients.title: Client management
clients.body:
Owner / farmer directory: identity, phone, email, address, client type and linked animals.

Search and filters find a record quickly; each client opens visit history and related patients.

clientsList.title: Client list & records
clientsList.body:
Card or table view: contact details, linked animals, last visit.

Open a record for full detail — in demo you browse without editing or deleting.

pets.title: Patients / animals
pets.body:
Core medical record: species, breed, sex, weight, ID (chip / tattoo), photo, status and owner.

From here you open the clinical file, consultations and shared-record import.

petsKpis.title: Patient indicators
petsKpis.body:
Global counters: total headcount, active animals, vaccine reminders, alerts.

They help the team prioritise follow-ups (boosters, ongoing treatments).

petsDossier.title: Patient medical record
petsDossier.body:
Each animal has a consolidated file: consultations, vaccinations, antiparasitics, attachments (X-rays, labs, clinical photos) and history.

Open a card for detail — the structure matches a real practice.

dossierImport.title: Record import / sharing
dossierImport.body:
Secure transfer of a medical record via code or QR: a partner clinic shares a temporary link, you import the file into VetoCrm.

Ideal for referrals, patient moves or inter-clinic collaboration — without retyping.

appointments.title: Calendar & appointments
appointments.body:
Schedule consultations, check-ups and reminders: calendar view, slots, statuses (confirmed, done, cancelled) and patient / reason link.

The agenda syncs the day’s flow with medical records.

visits.title: Field & farm visits
visits.body:
Rounds and off-site interventions: visit list, linked farm, on-site services (prophylaxis, surgery, follow-up).

Each visit can produce procedures, attachments and related billing.

consultations.title: Clinical consultations
consultations.body:
Structured medical act: reason, history, exam, diagnosis, treatment, prescription and notes.

Each consultation feeds the patient history and can carry attachments.

consultationsDocs.title: Documents & attachments
consultationsDocs.body:
X-rays, ultrasounds, lab reports, dermatology or post-op photos: attached to the consultation and visible in the record.

The clinic demo includes realistic examples (images, lab sheets) to show the document flow.

vaccinations.title: Vaccinations & protocols
vaccinations.body:
Track protocols (CHPPi, rabies, etc.), doses given, upcoming boosters and per-animal vaccine history.

Due dates feed dashboard and patient alerts.

vaccinationsCerts.title: Vaccine certificates (QR)
vaccinationsCerts.body:
Printable certificates / attestations with a verification QR code.

Useful for travel, boarding, farms or inspections — the document stays traceable from the record.

antiparasites.title: Antiparasitics
antiparasites.body:
Treatment calendar (fleas, ticks, deworming): product, date, next due and reminders.

Complements vaccinations in the patient prevention plan.

history.title: Consolidated medical history
history.body:
Single timeline of clinical events: consultations, vaccines, antiparasitics and related acts.

Filter by patient or period to rebuild the care journey quickly.

historyTimeline.title: Care journey & documents
historyTimeline.body:
Each timeline entry opens the act detail and linked documents.

This is the “full record” view for a review, referral or team handoff.

farms.title: Farms / herds
farms.body:
Farm records: type (cattle, sheep…), herd size, production, acreage, interventions and batch prophylaxis.

Key module for Clinic / Duo / Pro+ rural plans.

stock.title: Inventory & pharmacy
stock.body:
Medicines, vaccines, antiparasitics and consumables: quantities, alert thresholds, expiry, stock movements.

Connects clinical work to daily inventory management.

accounting.title: Clinic accounting
accounting.body:
Track revenue and expenses, lines linked to acts / visits, financial dashboards.

Gives an economic view of activity without leaving VetoCrm.

team.title: Team & roles
team.body:
Invite vets and assistants, roles (admin / assistant) and per-module permissions (view / edit).

On the public demo, team access may be limited; in a real trial you configure your organisation.

settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.body:
Identity (name, logo, address, phone), hours, veterinarians, print preferences and subscription options.

In read-only: browse settings without saving.

mobileNav.title: Mobile navigation
mobileNav.body:
On phone, the bottom bar opens essential sections (dashboard, clients, patients, calendar…).

The guided tour also adapts to small screens.

finish.title: Tour complete
finish.body:
You explored the Clinic Demo: patient records, documents, certificates, calendar, field work, stock and operations.

Everything stayed read-only to protect shared data.

Start a free trial to open your own clinic and work freely.
